Callout.Name: Laundering - Front Business
Callout.Message: Business believed to be laundering money through the till.
Callout.Advisory: Staff inside, paperwork behind the counter.

Script.Line: The takings are the takings. Some days are good and some days are bad.
I keep the books behind the counter. Everybody keeps the books behind the counter.
You can take the books. You cannot take my till.

Lines.Approach: The takings do not match the trade and the paperwork is behind the counter. Go in and ask to see it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
